attributeDefinition: Name of survey location site. Matches "location" in the other tables in this package.
Number of redds observed. Only includes full redds with a pot and a tail. Zero indicates the location was surveyed and no redds were found. Each 2024-2025 ground survey record is a single redd.
Number of salmon observed on the redd
Water depth in meters at the head of the redd. Measurements are not taken on every redd due to resource constraints.
Water depth in meters in the pot of the redd.
Water velocity in meters per second at 60% depth at the head of the redd. Measurements are not taken on every redd due to resource constraints.
Substrate composition of the redd as percent fine substrate (silt or sand), defined as less than 1 cm. Evaluated visually.
Substrate composition of the redd as percent small substrate (gravel), defined as 1-5 cm. Evaluated visually.
Substrate composition of the redd as percent medium substrate (cobble), defined as 6-15 cm. Evaluated visually.
Substrate composition of the redd as percent large substrate (large cobble), defined as 16-30 cm. Evaluated visually.
Substrate composition of the redd as percent boulder substrate, defined as greater than 30 cm. Evaluated visually.
Width of the redd in meters, measured at the widest part of the redd.
Length of the redd in meters, measured at the longest part of the redd.
Longitude of the redd in decimal degrees (WGS84). Measured at the center of the redd.
missingValueCodeExplanation: Not recorded, or record is a zero-redd survey record with no redd location

attributeDefinition: Latitude of the redd in decimal degrees (WGS84). Measured at the center of the redd.
missingValueCodeExplanation: Not recorded, or record is a zero-redd survey record with no redd location

attributeDefinition: Elevation at the redd point in feet.
Accuracy of the latitude and longitude measurements in feet.
TRUE if the redd observation was taken from a boat, FALSE otherwise.
